field_verifications.proposed_value: Purified, CD19 + B cells, re-suspended in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS)-EDTA + 0.5% bovine serum albumin (BSA), were added at 2 × 10 5 cells per well of a V-bottom, 96-well culture plate in a 50-μl volume. The B cells were then labelled with a combination of the above antibodies to give: (1) plasma cells, which were viable (PI − ) CD3 − CD14 − CD16 − CD19 + CD20 lo/- CD38 hi CD27 hi with subsets based on expression of CXCR3 and HLA-DR; (2) memory B cells, which were viable (PI − ) CD3 − CD14 − CD16 − CD19 + CD20 + CD43 − CD5 − CD27 + with subsets based on IgM and IgD expression (IgM + only, IgM + IgD + , IgD + only and switched IgM − IgD − ). The cells were analysed on a Beckman-Coulter Cyan Flow Cytometer with 9-colour parameters.
